notes.title: 2024/8/22 Update Log
notes.content:
Update feature 1: Added leisure mode, where there are no monster invasions and players can fully utilize their thinking abilities by pressing the time and step count in Wuxi
Update Function 2: Added a second restart and confirmation button to prevent players from accidentally touching it
We hope that players can provide their suggestions, and we will all listen carefully.
